notes.title: Cast Out Colony goes v1.0!
notes.content:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here!

We have FINALLY reached v1.0! Very proud of the team's hard work to reach this point, and very thankful for all of you that have been following along in the journey with us! 

Let's get to all the changes and additions in v1.0!

V1.0 Patch Notes

— CHARACTERS —
New Character - BUCK & WILD! You voted, we delivered! Buck & Wild joins the character roster! 

More about Buck & Wild:

 Starting Skill - Lasso (See Below in the Skills section)
 Banishing Blow - Rodeo - Wild jumps around wildly, trying to buck Buck off of her. This creates powerful, damaging shockwaves that can devastate your foes!
 Perks - +50% Speed. 5% Critical Damage every 10 levels (25% max)


ROXY - Now starts with +30% Knockback in addition to previous Perks.
QUEEN BEATRICE  - Now starts with 2 Cast Outs in addition to previous Perks.

New Stat - Boss Damage! Increasing this stat will allow you to do additional damage to bosses. This also stacks with your overall damage stat to all enemies.


— SKILLS —

NEW ACTIVE SKILL - Lasso

 Throw out a lasso in the direction the player is facing. Enemies that are hit by the lasso will take damage and, if the enemy survives, will also become temporarily stunned.


NEW PASSIVE SKILL - Bounty Hunter 

 10% additional damage will be done to bosses.


NEW PASSIVE SKILL - Revenge  

 When taking damage, your damage output will briefly increase.


NEW MYSTIC SKILL - Hogtie 

 Combination of Lasso and Bounty Hunter creates Hogtie. Hogtie is a larger version of Lasso that covers a larger area, as well as stuns enemies for a longer amount of time. However, it has a longer cooldown than Lasso and isn’t affected by the number of projectiles.


NEW MYSTIC SKILL - Sonic Boom and Scurry now combine to create Thunderstorm.
NEW MYSTIC SKILL - Decoy and Flower Coins(Passive Skill) now combine to create Explosive Decoy.
NEW MYSTIC SKILL - Zapper and Repel now combine to create Zappier.
NEW MYSTIC SKILL - Life Seed and Molt now combine to create Tree of Life.

Acid Spray’s projectile size increased by 66%
Acid Spray base damage increments increased by 5 on levels 2, 4, 7, and 9.

Stomp will no longer erase pick up items on the map. Instead, it will now have a small chance to pull in items.
Exterminate cooldown increased from 45s → 60s.

The following Mystic Skill combinations have been changed:

 Thorn Whip now combines with Strike to create Octovine.
 Stink now combines with Wingspan to create Toxicity.
 Leaf Shuriken now combines with Rush to create Leaf Barrage.
 Firecracker now combines with Echo to create Firework.
 Acorn now combines with Acorn Tree to create Buckeye.
 Seed Bomb now combines with Revenge to create Nuclear Nut. (Atomic Seed name changed due to player demand!)


— ENEMIES —

Enemies will no longer have their stun state refreshed if hit with a stun ability when already in the stunned state. Additionally, enemies will have a slight cooldown of 3 seconds (10 seconds for bosses) where they cannot be stunned again after the stun state has worn off.

New Enemy! Explosive Venus Fly Trap - These stagnant enemies will trigger an explosion when in the nearby area. Don’t get caught in the explosion!

– COMPANIONS –

The first Companion slot is unlocked by default.

Fixed an issue where the Companion select screen would not appear if Capt. Watchington & Crew were the only Companions built on the map.

Fixed an issue where Flealix and Capt. Watchington & Crew would have to be selected multiple times if previously selected when exiting the Player’s House menu.

– COLONY –

Optimized Colony saving to create small files sizes. Due to this, all Colonies will be resetting now the Early Access has ended. However, during our playtest, we were able to regain locked buildings (and skills) in a few runs. Sorry for this inconvenience, but the game will run smoother now and create much smaller file sizes for players.

Due to popular demand, dashing has been reactivated in the colony! 

Adjusted the follow clean up items when colony is first generated:
Number of Bottle Caps increase from 10 → 15
Number of small rocks decreased from 400 → 300
Number of weeds decreased from 400 → 300

Fixed an issue where talking to NPCs with multiple lines after already speaking with them would softlock the game.

— Arenas —
New Arena! Crystal Cave - This donut shaped arena provides a new gameplay experience!

Maple Ruins:

 Changed some of the skills that were buffed in the Maple Ruins blue aura.
 Red aura now debuffs those skills rather than buffing enemies.
 UI will pop up to show the player which skills are buffed/debuffed when in the respective aura.


Maple Ruins unlock cost decrease from 5000 → 4000
Happy Lil Forest unlock cost increased from 5000 → 5500
Hollowed Haven unlock cost increased from 5000 → 7000

NEW PICKUP ITEM - Mega Heart - Acorn Trees have an extremely rare chance to drop a Mega Heart, which heals the player for 50HP on pickup.

The following pickup item weights have changed:
Single Flower Coin - 57 → 50
10 Flower Coins - 9 → 25
25 Flower Coins - 5 → 15
100 Flower Coins 2 → 7.5
Reroll - 3 → 5
Zapper - 1 → 2

– UI Changes –
Reroll and Cast Out on the upgrade menu have been changed to button inputs.
If the Skill Tree is built in the colony, the player will be able to toggle the Mystic Menu in an Arena.

Banishing Blow portraits have been updated for Roxy, Mighty Green, Cid, and Queen Beatrice.

Various UI Visual Changes

notes.title: Cast Out Colony launches into Full Release on March 3rd!
notes.content:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here with BIIIIIIIG news!

🎉 CAST OUT COLONY WILL LAUNCH INTO V1.0 ON MARCH 3RD! 🎉

V1.0 brings:

1 NEW Character
3 NEW Skills
4 NEW Mystic Skills
1 NEW Arena
1 NEW Pick-Up Item
1 NEW Enemy Type
1 NEW Stat
Gameplay Balances, Changes, and Fixes
UI Updates


We've also changed how the colony, weapons, and buildings are saved to significantly improve saving/loading times and reduce file size. As a result, all Early Access colonies, weapons, and buildings will be reset. However, your other stats remain intact. In our playtests, it only took a few runs to re-unlock everything we previously had. We’re very sorry for this inconvenience, but the end result is a much smoother experience.

Lastly, as mentioned in the EOY update, Cast Out Colony will receive a slight price increase. In the US, the game will go from $8.99 to $9.99. (Price may vary based on your region) However, it will be on sale during the week of March 3rd to celebrate the launch!

Thank you to everyone who has been along for the ride! I hope you all enjoy the new additions and changes to Cast Out Colony!

notes.title: End of the Year Update!
notes.content:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here! Hope you all got to enjoy the holiday season and are looking forward to ushering in a brand spankin’ new year! 

The team and I thought it would be a good idea to give you all an “End of the Year” update on everything that has happened over the past few months and a glimpse of what is coming to Cast Out Colony in 2025! Let’s get to it, shall we?


The past few months
Back in September we let the community voice for the next character that will be joining the game in the full release of Cast Out Colony. Across all socials, discord, steam comments, etc., the winner and newest addition to the playable roster is…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/0a73708e41a5b543e5c2ee096506bc124447965c.png
Buck & Wild!

It ended up being a close race between Mosquiteer and Buck & Wild, but the duo pulled off the victory. I hope you all enjoy playing as them, whether you voted for or against the cowbug and his noble steed!

We’ve had them in the game internally since the end of October and they made their first public appearance at GDEX 2025, a game development convention in Columbus, Ohio. Some of you with dragonfly eyes might have noticed we updated the trailer with new footage of Buck & Wild around that time. We got to use the event as playtesting for the new character (they were quite a popular pick) and players really enjoyed the character’s overall play style. If you are reading this and you were at the convention, thank you so much for stopping by, playing the game, chatting with us, and showing your support! Oh, and since we are talking about GDEX…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/5e78c8fbb077c9dff40c157240135f02b84707e3.png
WE WON A FREAKIN’ AWARD!

Although there were TONS of awesome games on display, we were honored to receive the Best in Show - Unreleased Game! This award means a lot to the team not only as a reflection of hard work paying off, but it also comes from our hometown! We love being a part of the Columbus game dev scene, and hope to continue to contribute for years to come! 

On to 2025
We have spent the past few months polishing up Cast Out Colony for a full v1.0 release. Although we don’t have an exact release date yet, we can say that you all will be able to play all the new content very soon! 

Something that we do want to be transparent about is that upon v1.0 release, the price of that game will be increasing very slightly. We wanted to have a lower price point during Early Access as a “thank you” for players willing to trust us to complete this game. Since release back in April, the game’s content has grown so much and we appreciate all of you that have backed us with your support and feedback.

Lastly, as a bit of a gift from us to you, we wanted to share the new Arena that you all will be able to play very soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/062b87f02152d478d33d9d684d048888fe375e34.jpg
CRYSTAL CAVE (In development)

Thank you all for a great 2024! See you in 2025!

notes.title: Updated Companions & Other Gameplay Tweaks
notes.content:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here! 

It's been a while since our last update, so we have some things to talk about! This patch not only updates Cinnamona's and Flealix's 3D models (they look so good, btw!) but also changes a major gameplay structure for our Arenas. So let's take a brief dive into this change.

The gate in the Arena will no longer open for early escape in the later portions of the waves, but rather *roughly* at the midway point (depending on the Arena). 

For example, in the Dark Forest, which has 24 waves total, the gate opened for early escape on wave 20. Now it is wave 12! That seems EXTREMELY early, but another change is that the gate is only open for a single wave and if the player decides to stay and fight, the gate closes and will NOT open until the Arena is conquered!

That might sound strange, but let's discuss a few reasons why we've decided to make this change.

[olist]
 We noticed that players felt like the time between the gate opening and completing the Arena was not significant enough to leave early. Feedback we've gotten was that the risk was low and players would rarely choose escape over fight. We think changing when the gate opens and shutting it until all waves and bosses are defeated greatly increases the risk/reward that we were originally wanting.
 Give an opportunity for players that just want a very short run to jump out at that early escape point and collect their reward, although it does not count as a True Survival.
[/olist]

Hope you all like this change! As always, I want to thank all of you for playing and for your continued support! We have some more cool things planned in the future, but always love to hear what you think!

Now, to the patch notes:

v0.4 Patch Notes


Gameplay Changes

 Adjusted times when gate will open in an Arena.
 Points for a Survival (Note: not True Survival) has been decreased due to the gate opening much sooner. 4000 → 1000


Companion Changes

 Cinnamona has received an updated character model!
 Flealix has received an updated character model!


Colony Changes

 New Villager House Type - Acorn Home
 Fountain has received updated model.
 Added individual character stats to book in the Library. 
Some of these stats are new additions to the stats that were being tracked. Pre-existing players will see some stats that don’t add up correctly. 
Example: If you add up all the individual stats for enemies defeated, they won’t equal the total enemies defeated on the general enemy stat page. This is because we’ve always been tracking the number of enemies a player has defeated for skill unlocks, but have only been tracking how many enemies an individual character has defeated behind the scenes in v0.3.1 (That was our little secret)



 General UI updates

notes.title: A new character has joined the colony!
notes.content:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here!

We are happy to release our first new addition to the roster! Leep O'Nardo joins the colony, and bring not only a unique twist to a new playable character, but TONS of new features. Read below for all the patch notes in v0.2!

Also, if you are enjoying the game, PLEASE leave a review! Our next goal is to hit 50 total and we can't do it without your help! Big thank you to those that have already taken the time to leave us a review! 

EA 0.2 Patch Notes

Character Changes:


New Character: Leep O’Nardo!
 Leep’s playstyle is drastically different from our other characters. He has +30% luck, and -20% everything else! His runs rely on good fortune to obtain rare chest, critical hits, items from acorn trees, etc. We really enjoyed playtesting him, and we hope you do too!

 Mighty Green - Base speed increased by 20%.
 Leaf Shuriken - Base damage increased by 10.

New Stats: 
 Acorn - Increases the maximum number of acorn trees that can spawn.
 Critical Hit Chance - Chance to deal critical damage.
 Critical Damage - Increases the amount of damage dealt on critical strikes.
 With the addition of Critical Hit Chance, Luck has a lesser chance of causing a critical hit.

New Companion: Flealix!
 Flealix is the owner of a small merchant booth (See Colony Changes) that will join the player in Arenas! Every so often Flealix will throw a useful item from his shop to the player!


Skill Changes:

New Active Skills 
[olist]
 Decoy - Throw scarecrows to distract your foes!
 Sunbeam - Rays of light randomly strike around the character.
 Moonbeam - The glow of the moon strikes at the character’s location.
[/olist]
New Passive Skills
[olist]
 Nice Dice - Extra Rerolls.
 Cast Out - Extra Cast Outs.
 Acorn Tree - Increase the number of acorn trees in an Arena.
 Strike - Crit Damage.
 Precision - Crit Hit Chance.
[/olist]
Other Skill Changes:

 Molt has been changed from an Active Skill to a Passive Skill.
 Eruption’s weapon image has been updated to the correct color.
 Fixed glitch where Atomic Seed could be obtained without Repel.



 Reworked casting out skills so that players can pick a skill even after casting out a skill. However, if a player casts out all 3 skills on the upgrade menu, the game will resume without the player receiving a new skill.


Colony Changes:


 Merchant - This new structure will let you purchase an item to take to an Arena and use when the player sees fit.
 Villager House’s grid layout has been adjusted.
 Luck, Critical Hit Chance, and Critical Damage have been added to Enrichment Level stats.
 Cooldown removed from the Enrichment Level stats.


Colony Items Added:

 Log Mailbox
 Streetlight
 Metal Bench
 Axe in Stump
 Trail Sign
 Wide Stone Arch
 Green Vending Machine
 Leep Statues (Stone, Gold, Diamond, Ruby)
 Haybale
 Box Scarecrow
 Scarecrow
 Chunky Scarecrow


These new items can be obtained in various ways including the Carpenter Shop, leveling up skills, or obtaining true survivals at Leep!


Other Things:


 Added a Starting and Ending Banner in the combat tutorial arena.
 Tutorials can no longer be exited unless at the final slide.
 34 New Achievements!

notes.title: v0.1.3 brings new modes!
notes.content:
Hey! Nathan the Game Dev here. 

Been awesome to see every enjoying Cast Out Colony! Thank you to everyone that has left us a review here on Steam, or given feedback in the Discord! We are really looking forward to continue to bring you a really fun game that shakes up some of the norm of the bullet heaven genre.

That said... v.01.3 is here and it brings mode modes! Thought you mastered the game? Think again! 

Our two new levels of difficulty, ECLIPSE and BLOOD MOON, will challenge your skills and might make you question if your character's build is good enough. Just like Normal and Crescent Moon, surviving all the waves and defeating all the bosses will unlock special statues of that character that will prove useful to your enrichment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/eee7a96fd2963b4a701dbde798ab63155db837dc.png

Also tagging along is ENDLESS MODE! In this mode the gate will not open. You are trapped in the Arena with your enemies until you can no longer fight. How long do you think you can survive?

Here are all the changes in the latest patch:

EA 0.1.3 Patch Notes


 Eclipse and Blood Moon difficulties added. Will you be able to conquer these new challenges?
 Endless Mode has been added. Escape from an Arena to unlock this mode in its respective Arena. How long can you survive the fangs of your foes?
 Adjusted Stat Boost in the Café.
 Fixed glitch that turned on active skills after using Banishing Blow after a total victory.
 Fixed glitch that player could activate Banishing Blow after exiting the Arena.
 Fixed graphical error in Carpenter shop.
 Fixed glitch when leveling up after escaping through the gate softlocked the game.
 Fixed glitch where Crescent Moon wasn’t saving correctly in an Arena's data.
 Fixed issue where game wasn’t saving current rotation on objects that were rotated after their initial placement.
 Added visual indicator on the Gate to help communicate what wave the gate will open.

notes.title: R&R: Roadmap and Reviews
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Game Dev Nathan here. First of all, I want to thank everyone that has shown support for the game. I know we have quite a way to go through early access, but the general positivity about the game has been uplifting to the team! We've been working hard to bring players something fun! Shoutout to the handful of players that have already been playing for 15 hours in the 2 days since release!

If you have been enjoying the game PLEASE leave a review. We are a small indie team so letting others know what you thought about the game is an incredibly massive help! We really want to keep steady development on the game. If Steam decides to push it in front of people and they decide to purchase, that helps us be able to keep working on the game at a consistent full-time rate. Reaching 10 reviews is crucial at this point in the game’s development. 

Again, please leave a review. Only takes a few moments and you can even make a bug joke or two, and it goes soooo far to help the game.

That said, I did want to share a little about the future of the game. We have some BIG plans for our lil’ bug game. In addition to our plans, we will also be keeping an eye out for what our players want to see from the game. Please take a look below at our roadmap that will better give an idea as to what you can expect in the remainder of the year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/a7c189c9244765739dc86740c8cf16eac3276bad.png

Also note that this doesn't mean that this is the limit on what we are creating, but rather what we already have plans for behind the scenes. If you want something in the game, join the Discord and let us know! We want to make something that you will continue to enjoy playing! 

We will be updating the game soon with new features, so be sure to keep an antenna out. 
Until then, here are some patch notes for some bugs that we squashed! 

See you in the colony! 
- Nathan

EA 0.1.2b Patch Notes


 Toxic skill’s scaling has been fixed.
 Detection collider for moving the Crafting Table has been increased.

 Nectar can no longer be obtained from a treasure chest if the player has already been revived prior to opening the chest.

notes.title: Demo v1.4! Big changes for our little bugs!
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! 

We have updated our demo! This update changes a core gameplay feature. Please take a look at the patch notes below.



Demo 1.4 Patch Notes (3-21-24):

Combat Arenas
We have changed where the player fights for the combat portion of the game. Players will no longer fight in the colony they build, but in a completely different area that we are calling Arenas. 

As we watched gamers play our demo, from the initial upload to the most recent update for Steam Next Fest, we began to realize that players did not want to build their colony since they felt that if they built too much, they were hindering their own survival. Even after giving incentives to build (extra Flower Coins, stat boost, etc.) it just became more clear based on what we watched and feedback we received that we needed to pivot. We feel that creating Arenas for combat solves this issue, and gives us creativity to create fun and unique Arenas further down the road. 

The demo has 1 arena available and we are planning on having more unique arenas ready to play in the full version of the game. 

Overall, the core game loop remains the same: playing in the combat phase gives resources to build the colony and growing your colony helps you grow your stats.

Please note that due to this change, some features did get cut, such as the traps. We do have plans to work those back into the game, but in a different way.



Companions
We have added a Companion System to the game! When certain Structures are built in your colony, there will be an NPC that will be able to join you in combat!

As of now, we have 3 Companions, (all of which use generic villager models for now), but there are plans to add more, and give them their unique 3D models!




Clean Up
We've introduced a new feature called 'Clean Up' to further enrich the colony building experience. When you first start your colony, it will be a mess. To create room to build objects in your colony, you’ll have to clear a spot for it. Cleaning up items will grant you extra flower coins, and if you have villagers in your colony, they will pitch in to assist!

The items to clean up are spawned procedurally, so your colony will be unique from all the others to give each player a slightly different experience!



Other Stuff
We have made general changes here and that you might spot if you are returning to the demo. 

We have added an opening sequence, spread out and simplified our tutorials, made enemy stat changes, changed the way some skills/buildings can unlock (Please note that even though the library will give the secret to unlock something, not everything will be able to be unlocked in the demo), made tons of UI changes, and so much more! 

As always, feel free to share your thoughts in the feedback forum or in our Discord server!

notes.title: Demo v1.3 Update! (02-02-2024)
notes.content:
Hey there! 

We are LIVE with a new demo update, just in time for Steam Next Fest! (Wooo!)

Let's go over some changes to the demo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/1fe0e29556a1d18a363016d7225b800ed5ae7d8f.png

Demo 1.3 Patch Notes:
Combat and Enemy Changes


 Dash Skills
Last update, we changed how the dash worked. This update, we have Dash Skills! These skills trigger when the player dashes.

 Cut Currency: Gold Coin
We tried to make the Gold Coins work, which played a bigger part in the original game's design, but it ended up confusing players. "Idk what the coins are for..." was a statement we heard a lot in let's play videos. We purged them from existence, leaving the Flower Coins as the only currency. 

 Enemies and Bosses
We have adjusted the speed and health of many enemies, as well as when they spawn. Speaking of spawning, the game will now pick between 2 different bosses every night, who now have a set HP amount, rather than scaling with the player, as it was before. As always, to win a night, you MUST defeat the boss, even if it means going into extra waves.

 TREASURE!
When you defeat a miniboss or boss, a treasure chest will drop! Now, when you get near it you will see a fun little animation with the skill(s) that get leveled up from the chest. I say skills with the "(s)" because there is now a chance that it'll be a rare chest and upgrade multiple skills that you have!



Colony Changes


 Colony Enrichment
Players can now place objects around their colony to increase a colony's enrichment. When the enrichment level is increased, the player will gain a permanent stat boost based on that level.

 Building Stat Boost
In addition to Colony Enrichment, structures will also give a stat boost to the player as long as it is built in the colony.

 Building Blueprint Cost
Before, when the player unlocked a blueprint after a night, it required Flower Coins to fully unlock before building the object. We have gotten rid of this. As soon as you unlock it through gameplay, you can build it the next day, free of charge. :) We hope this also shortens the early portion of the game and gets you into the thick of it much quicker!

 New Building: Library
Players can now unlock a library! The Library will let you gain better insight into how to unlock skills and other buildings! (NOTE: Not all skills and buildings are included in the demo and will not unlock even after meeting the requirements for unlock.) Here, you can also touch up on anything you might need to re-learn.

 Cut Building: Bank
Due to the cutting of the gold coin, the Bank no longer served a purpose. However, we are exploring ways to bring it back in some other way and give it a new purpose. But for now, the safe is locked in... another safe?



That's it for now! Everyone enjoy Steam Next Fest! Don't forget to Wishlist, tell your friends to Wishlist, and tell your pets to Wishlist! Talk to you soon!

- Wooshido Dev Team

notes.title: Cast Out Colony Demo Updates! (12-16-23)
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! 
We have updated our demo with NEW content! Please see the patch notes below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/9f5c45260655e91f408a81b1702340e65792aafa.png

Demo 1.1 Patch Notes:

Colony Progression
We've added more to the colony aspect of the game. (It is called Cast Out Colony, for a reason!) Yay, meta-progression!

1. Expansion
When you first start your colony, only a small percentage will be able to be built on. However, with the use of flower coins, you may expand your colony, amount of traps, and amount of villagers. This way, we hope not to overwhelm any first timers in building too much too early. Now there is a nice steady progression in your colony, and you’ll have to be more mindful of your colony management.


2. Colony Bonus
Going hand in hand with the prior bullet point, we noticed through gameplay videos of playtesters and the first batch of YouTube videos playing the 1.0 demo (Yes, we watch them ALL). Most players opted to keep skipping to night, and did not find any benefit in building a colony. While this may be true in the early phases of the game, structures play a crucial part in a colony as the game progresses. To help with unlocking these structures faster and encourage building your colony, we have implemented a Colony Bonus that will give you a percentage of extra Flower Coins at the end of a run.


3. Enemies Movement Speed
Something that we noticed quite early into development was that when there was too much built on the map, it became more of a hindrance to the player. We have now implemented a mechanic that slows down the enemies depending on how much you have built in your colony.


Building Changes
A few of the Structures have been modified to help in the meta-progression.

Bank - We have added a spot in the bank’s menu where players can now exchange coins on their person (…or bug?) and exchange them for Flower Coins. This exchange rate does change every day, so be sure to check back in on it to try to get that coveted 1:1!

Gym - The gym originally gave the player the opportunity to level up their character for a set amount of coins. This was a temporary boost for your character on that run. Now you can get a PERMA BUFF for all of your characters across all runs at the gym using Flower Coins.


Some Other Things...
Flower Coin Passive Skill 
We have added a passive skill that can be unlocked (Hint: Use Roxy) to give an extra boost to the amount of Flower Coins given after a run.

We are continuing to give the player more options of props to build in their colony, and have added more! Check your shop to see if it is in stock!

We noticed sometimes players won’t see a skill defeating a boss, and thus, not seeing the treasure chest. We added an offscreen indicator to those chests and to acorn trees, as well.

Various UI changes.
